^xFFFF77bandit: ^7 Help alira early then respec lategame. ^xE05030 ---------------------IMPORTANT INFO BEFORE USING ^x70FF70ECHOES OF CREATION^7--------------------------------------------------------------
Do not use helmet until you have the full setup otherwise you will kill your character with self damage.
Need timeless jewel + >7% PDR on chest + implicit + Divine Shield keystone and general good gear/armour to reduce the self damage.
^x70FF70SUPPRESSION^7
In order to have enough mitigation for echoes you will need EXCEPTIONAL arm/eva gear to be able to sustain the self hits and also reach suppression cap. this means the gear will be REALLY REALLY expensive and as such I did not make a pob for it because it is out of reach for most players imo.
DO NOT get baited to go suppression cap early, you will need t1 on every item + small clusters + suppression annoint most likely. if you want some inspiration here is my character from last league https://pobb.in/4TL7Y_vICnN8.
^x7070FF^x8888FF^xD02090^x70FF70MANA MANAGEMENT^7^7^7^7
^xB97123Use ENDURING mana flask until mana leech jewel + 1 elreon craft. *****REQUIRED*** AS SOON as you start maps OR YOU MUST RUN ONE LESS WARCRY ON AUTO. ^7 2x elreon craft allows you to have free warcrys and remove lifetap from your earthshatter supports.
For fissure, I would lifetap in links and use mana flask until you have clever thief annoint (cheap) or get 2x elreon and use mana leech on infernal cry to drop lifetap.
^x70FF70GEM QUALITY^7
Your warcries pop the earthshatter spikes so you should try to stagger the quality (example: Intimidating at 20 quality, Seismic at 19 quality etc etc.)
I would recommend getting 20 quality on earthshatter before mapping begins and DEFINITELY 20 quality on snaking if playing that.
^x70FF70Endurance charge sustain
^7Early on you will sustain from endurance charge on kill + selfcasting enduring cry on bosses if you have an open socket for it.
Towards the endgame i like to get endurance charge mod on chest implicit with a grand+ ember(might need to conflict) so that i can completely ignore them and know they will always be at max unless i run a remove charge map(dont run those). make sure you pay attention to your endurance charge duration + maybe click small node near devotion. ^7 Weapon swapping to Redblade Banner with Enduring cry allows you start the map/boss with max endurance charges so you can completely avoid the ramp time.
